scope.denominator: Every non-sentinel value returned by original APK v1 FunctionType, v2 FunctionType, and BLE ModelFeature.values().
excluded: Android-only UI, cloud account workflows, media applications themselves
Firmware transfer and installation; firmware version and update information remain in scope
qualifications: Capability counts are not semantic protocol coverage. Each capability may contain multiple schemas, states and optional subcommands.
BLE ModelFeature reports device-declared integration capability only; this does not require implementing Spotify, Alexa, Chromecast or Google accounts.
Static implementation status is separate from verification. Existing source paths never count as passing tests.
No model-name-to-capability assumptions. Device support requires capabilities reported by that device.
Legacy inquiry enums omit KMP-migrated inquiry values; dispatch registries and KMP classes remain part of protocol evidence.
Required stage IDs are minimum verification obligations, not a claim of exhaustive schema cases.
An exercised stage only means its current registered executable cases passed. It does not establish complete schema or application behavior coverage.
Static implementation claims with missing or changed inspection fingerprints are reported as unassessed or stale; they do not establish current implementation.
unresolved: Every feature needs audited case bindings and complete per-schema edge/state coverage before a claim of full behavioral equivalence.
Some protocol family mappings remain unresolved; these entries cannot become fully verified.

device_family_evidence.policy: No capability claims inferred from SonyDeviceModel names or marketing families.

inspection_caveats: Inspected source, not prior review conclusions. No hardware/protocol probing, no builds/tests.
Default missing codes require FunctionType-name join by generation+table+code. Equal hex codes across generations/tables are different functions.
v2 DISPLAY_FW_VERSION 1B not explicitly capability-gated: generic firmware query 04/02 always runs; treat separately rather than claim full function implementation.
NO_USE is a sentinel, not a user feature.
Fast Pair earbud finder is a separate path, not an APK FunctionType.
Playback protocol/controller exists, but no direct playback/music/call volume controls in inspected MenuBarView/SettingsView surfaces; consider partial end-to-end UI coverage.
Touch custom gesture UI limits function options to 0x01...0x04 (SettingsView.swift:1242 gestures/:1300 gesturePicker), controller custom actions require v2.
STAMINA additionally requires fixed alerts enabled and T1 function90 (SonyHeadphonesController.swift:3841).
Speaker models are accepted: SonyProtocol.swift:320 SonyDeviceModel and SonyDeviceCoordinator.swift:12 SonyConnectedDevice.init; model acceptance does not establish speaker feature support.
Fast Pair finder hard allowlist WF-1000XM5 firmware6.1.0 only (EarbudFinderController.swift:24).
